news.title: First half 2026 earnings released: EPS: ₹2.04 (vs ₹0.98 in 1H 2025)
news.body: First half 2026 results: EPS: ₹2.04 (up from ₹0.98 in 1H 2025). Revenue: ₹168.1m (up 38% from 1H 2025). Net income: ₹22.6m (up 181% from 1H 2025). Profit margin: 13% (up from 6.6% in 1H 2025). The increase in margin was driven by higher revenue.
